# Sofira Blueprints

> Sofira Blueprints is the email marketing and CRM automation practice of Sofiat Adedeji, a Top Rated freelancer on Upwork with a 100% Job Success Score, working with clients worldwide. Sofira Blueprints designs, builds and tests automation that follows up with every lead and brings customers back, for e-commerce brands, coaches and creators, SaaS companies, IT and B2B businesses, and agencies.

## Services
- Email flows and campaigns: welcome series, abandoned cart and checkout, browse abandonment, post-purchase, win-back, sunset flows and newsletters (Klaviyo, Mailchimp, MailerLite, ActiveCampaign, Kit/ConvertKit, GetResponse, Keap)
- CRM setup and automation: pipelines, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, lead nurturing, review requests, missed-call text-back (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Keap, ActiveCampaign, Zoho)
- CRM and email platform migration with field mapping, consent checks and reconciliation
- Email deliverability: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, sending domains, list cleaning; SMS compliance and A2P 10DLC registration
- Zapier and Make integrations, including Shopify, Calendly, Google Workspace, Slack and Stripe
- Funnels and landing pages (Systeme.io, GoHighLevel), cold email outreach (Instantly) and AI employees (GoHighLevel Voice AI and Conversation AI)

## Credentials
- Upwork: Top Rated, 100% Job Success Score, identity verified
- Certifications: Klaviyo Practitioner, GoHighLevel Expert, Advanced Email Marketing, Email Marketing, Digital Marketing
- Languages: English (fluent), Spanish, French and Japanese (conversational)
